title: APIForge vs Postman: OpenAPI-Native vs Collection-First
description: Compare APIForge and Postman for OpenAPI specification linting, quality scoring, zero-CORS testing, and web-first developer workflow.
heroSubtitle: Spec-Native Quality Workbench vs Collection HTTP Client
verdict: Postman is an extensive API platform focused on workspace collaboration and manual HTTP collections. APIForge is specialized for OpenAPI-native developers who want instant spec parsing, quality scoring, schema validation, zero-CORS testing, and shareable public reports without account signups.

sections.title: OpenAPI Specification Native Workflows
sections.description: Postman converts OpenAPI specs into Postman Collections. APIForge works directly on the underlying OpenAPI specification, preserving custom extensions, $ref chains, and JSON Schema contracts.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account to use APIForge?
faqs.answer: No. APIForge is completely open and web-native. You can paste any URL or file and start testing and scoring immediately.
